description: JEE Main Section A MCQ: +4 for correct option, -1 for incorrect option, 0 for unattempted.
JEE Main Section B Numerical (2022+): +4 for correct numerical value, -1 for incorrect, 0 for unattempted.
JEE Advanced Section 1 Single Correct: +3 for correct choice, -1 for incorrect choice, 0 if unattempted.
JEE Advanced Multi-Correct: +4 if all correct chosen, partial marks (+3, +2, +1), -2 if any incorrect chosen, 0 if unattempted.
JEE Advanced Numerical: +4 for correct numerical/decimal answer, 0 in all other cases (no negative marking).
JEE Advanced Integer (Single Digit / Non-negative Integer): +3 or +4 for correct integer, 0 otherwise.
JEE Advanced Matching List / Matrix Match: +3 for correct match combination, -1 for incorrect, 0 if unattempted.
